content.text:
**Finding submitted — WARRANTY (needs_review, fallback target).**

- **What the document says:** SFJ's only representation/warranty is the funding covenant at 13.5 (p0739). All other warranty content in Article 13 is PB-side (13.1–13.4), and 13.6.2 disclaims everything "EXCEPT AS OTHERWISE SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13" (p0743). SFJ's performance obligations (e.g., 3.1.4 compliance, 3.1.5 SFJ SOPs) are efforts covenants, not a warranty with a remedy.
- **Why actionable:** No conformance warranty for the SFJ Services plus a sweeping disclaimer sits at walk-away, not fallback.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** new 13.5.1 in Article 13 — 30-day conformance warranty for the SFJ Services with re-performance/repair/replacement or refund at PB's election; placed inside Article 13 so the 13.6.2 carve-out preserves it.
- **Open item:** the fallback's software-to-documentation element is inapplicable — the Agreement contains no software, deliverables or SFJ-supplied documentation — so it is mapped unaddressed for business confirmation rather than papered with inoperative boilerplate.
